mLocKeys.keySummary: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Thresh's Attacks deal additional damage based on how long since he last Attacked. They deal between @PAttackDamageMin@ and @PAttackDamageMax@ magic damage.

Active: Thresh whips his chains, Pulling or Pushing enemies in the direction of the swing. Enemies hit are also Slowed by @Effect2Amount@% for @Effect4Amount@ second and take @TotalDamage@ magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Passive damage scales with number of <keywordMajor>Souls</keywordMajor> collected.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Thresh can harvest the souls of enemies that die near him, permanently granting him Armor and Ability Power.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Thresh collects the <keywordMajor>Souls</keywordMajor> of dead enemies by walking near them. Each <keywordMajor>Soul</keywordMajor> grants him <scaleArmor>@StatValuePerSoul@ Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleAP>@StatValuePerSoul@ Ability Power</scaleAP>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_ThreshPassiveSouls_Tooltip}}

Current Soul Bonuses: @CurrentSoulBonus@ Ability Power, @CurrentSoulBonus@ Armor

Champions and large minions always drop a Soul, while small minions and jungle monsters only sometimes drop one. Epic jungle monsters drop two Souls.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Thresh throws out his scythe, Stunning the first unit hit and Pulling them towards Thresh for @TauntLength@ seconds. The scythe does @TotalDamage@ magic damage and also grants True Sight for the duration.

Thresh can Recast this Ability to pull himself to the enemy.

If this Ability hits, its Cooldown is reduced by @HitBonusCooldown@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Thresh pulls himself to the poor soul.

mLocKeys.keySummary: A prison of walls that slow and deal damage if broken.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Thresh creates a prison of spectral walls, <status>Slowing</status> champions by @Effect3Amount@% for @Effect2Amount@ seconds and dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. Walls break after one collision, and after one is broken, the rest deal no damage and <status>Slow</status> for half duration.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Thresh throws his lantern, allowing an ally to click on it to dash to Thresh.

The lantern also grants @TotalShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds to Thresh and the first ally champion to come in contact with it.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The <shield>Shield</shield> scales with number of <keywordMajor>Souls</keywordMajor> collected. Thresh can use his lantern to pick up <keywordMajor>Souls</keywordMajor>.</rules>
